from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0]
                 for c in range(w)]

    # Repeating non-field rows and columns form the lattice separators.
    common_line_color = Counter(row_modes + col_modes).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color != common_line_color]
    cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color != common_line_color]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    separator_color = Counter([row_modes[r] for r in rows] +
                              [col_modes[c] for c in cols]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    field_cells = [grid[r][c]
                   for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:])
                   for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:])
                   for r in range(r0 + 1, r1)
                   for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
    field_color = Counter(field_cells).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # A lattice cell is marked when all four junctions have the same
    # non-separator color; every other cell takes the repeated field color.
    points = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    result = [[field_color for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)]
              for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]
    marked = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            color = points[i][j]
            if color in (field_color, separator_color):
                continue
            if all(points[ri][cj] == color
                   for ri, cj in ((i, j + 1), (i + 1, j), (i + 1, j + 1))):
                result[i][j] = color
                marked.append((i, j))
    if not marked:
        return [[field_color]]

    r0 = min(i for i, _ in marked)
    r1 = max(i for i, _ in marked)
    c0 = min(j for _, j in marked)
    c1 = max(j for _, j in marked)
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in result[r0:r1 + 1]]
